concept.title: Repairing or replacing a motor
concept.shortdesc: If the motor or any of its parts are repaired or needs to be replaced,

conbody.p: If the motor or any of its parts are repaired or needs to be replaced, the new part or motor’s details need to be updated in the .
Important: A new learning process is necessary in both cases.

ul.li: If a new motor is installed, request a new set of fixing clamps from your ADI sales representative.
It is not necessary to replace the fixing clamps in case of repair work.

conbody.p: To update motor details on the :

ol.li: Log in to the and tap Dashboard.
Tap Listand find the motor that is in repair.
Select the motor to view the motor details

li.p: Tap Edit Motor to update the necessary fields.
Based on the data provided, the displays more information about the motor. You can edit this information, if required.

section.title: Result
section.note: After the new or repaired motor is running again, ensure that the is connected by following the procedure in Post Installation .
